voxel_um_note: Physical voxel spacing is NOT known for this stack. The TIFF carries only a bogus inch-based XResolution (InsightToolkit default) and no Z step. Do not assume the MERFISH project spacing (0.15 um xy, 1.0 um z) applies here — that is a different acquisition. Projections and segmentation may run in VOXEL space; physical-um geometry and the um clock are blocked until the lab provides verified xy pixel size and z spacing.
channels_note: Channel identity (e.g. DNA vs cell-surface) is not recorded in the file and has not been confirmed. Treated as a single unnamed intensity channel until confirmed.
notes: Matched by dimensions (251 x 2303 x 2304) to Segmentation-label_1.tif. One embryo. Fixed-style snapshot with no true tau. Usable for target-domain preprocessing, segmentation QC and OOD; not a supervised tau label.
